primary_action.label: READY TO CATCH MY FIRST WAVE

findings.title: Every Book button on the lodge and level pages loses the package the visitor chose
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On the Level two page, tapping BOOK YOUR STAY opens the booking engine's front page, which shows one 'Sri Lanka' tile and nothing else; the same happens from the lodge page, Level one ('READY TO CATCH MY FIRST WAVE'), Level three, Freestyle and the home page hero, so the visitor has to tap 'Sri Lanka', find their level again and start over.
findings.playbook_ref: §5 booking path ('the chosen details carried over')
findings.fix_in_new_site: one bookingLinks[] row per package pointing at its engine product page (https://globalsurfadventures.bookinglayer.com/en/product/level-1-fomies, …/level-2-rollers, …/level-3-riders), never a /tests/ or /frontoffice/ URL; each lessons[] row sits beside its own link
findings.notes: All seven site buttons walked on 2026-09-28 (funnel/walk.json → engine_handoffs): the /tests/ URLs 302 to /en/tests/… which the engine renders as its front page. funnel.mjs 0.1.2 classes these as book_link, not engine, because it knows bookinglayer.io but not bookinglayer.com.

findings.title: No price for any Kabalana package on the site; the first price is 7 taps away, inside the engine
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The lodge page, the packages page and the four level pages show no price and no currency; a visitor starting on the lodge page sees the first price only after BOOK YOUR STAY → 'Sri Lanka' → a level → Choose guests → + → Choose dates → a Saturday, when the engine's bar reads 'Total: $1466'.
findings.fix_in_new_site: lessons[] rows for Level 1/2/3 with price, currency USD, unit per_person and '7 nights' in the label, capture date shown (playbook §7), each with its bookingLinks[] row; the room supplement stays in the engine
findings.notes: Text scan of home, lodge, packages, level one/two/three and free-style pages for $, €, ₪, USD, EUR, NIS, 'price', 'per week', 'per night': no line matched (funnel/walk.json → checks). The only prices on globalsurf.com are the Maldives charter table (F11).

findings.title: The one page whose buttons open the right package is not linked from the site
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The 'Sri Lanka Lodge — Weekly Surf & Wellness Retreats' page has three MAKE A RESERVATION cards that open each level's own engine page, but no menu, home, lodge, level or contact page links to it, and on a phone the cards start about six screens down.
findings.playbook_ref: §3 content hierarchy (offers with prices second on the page); §5
findings.fix_in_new_site: the packages are the second block of the one page (playbook §3 item 2): lessons[] rows with their bookingLinks[] on the page every visitor lands on
findings.notes: No link to /kabalana-lodge-surf-packages/ in the HTML of any of the 30 pages funnel.mjs crawled; the page is listed in page-sitemap.xml (lastmod 2024-02-09). Level 1 card at y≈5437 of a 9360-px page on a 844-px screen.

findings.title: The Freestylers B&B package is advertised with a Book button but cannot be booked on any date
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The Freestyle page offers the B&B package with BOOK YOUR STAY; in the engine, after choosing a guest, every day from September 2026 to September 2027 is struck through.
findings.playbook_ref: §2 'What does it cost?'; §7 honesty of facts
findings.fix_in_new_site: no lessons[] row and no bookingLinks[] row for Freestylers while the engine has no dates; a room-only visitor gets the Booking.com bookingLinks[] row instead

findings.title: The site and the engine promise different things for the same package
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The Level one page lists 'Yoga sessions x 5' and '1 on 1 feedback session x 2'; the engine's LEVEL 1 package lists no yoga, '1 One on one feedback session' and '1 Ayurvedic spa treatment', so the visitor cannot tell what the price buys.
findings.fix_in_new_site: lessons[].includes carries only what both sources state, or only the engine's list (it is what the visitor pays for); one fact in one field (site-content 'No duplication')
findings.notes: Same mismatch on levels two and three per dossier.json#offers[].includes_site vs includes_engine; only Level 1 was re-opened by hand.

findings.title: The lodge page downloads about 20 MB on a phone before any scroll
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: Opening the lodge page on a phone pulls 19.96 MB in 204 requests from 20 other hosts (YouTube video hero, two Kuula 360° viewers, Google Ads/DoubleClick, Facebook, Analytics, an Instagram feed, a chat widget) before the visitor scrolls; the home page is 13.44 MB / 146 requests / 16 other hosts and the packages page 13.87 MB / 212 requests.
findings.playbook_ref: §4 mobile on bad connections (first load ≤ 1.5 MB, third-party requests on load 0)
findings.fix_in_new_site: playbook §4 budget as built by the template: photos[] served as responsive AVIF/WebP, no video hero, no third-party request on load
findings.notes: Auditor's own single headless run, 390×844, unthrottled, load + 6 s, no scroll (funnel/walk.json → site_pages); agrees with the harvester's run (13.44 MB / 19.95 MB).

findings.title: The floating chat bubble covers text on every page, and 'Start Chat' asks for a Messenger login
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: A Messenger bubble with a red badge sits over the bottom-right of the text on every screen; tapping it shows 'Typically replies within a day' and 'Start Chat', which opens messenger.com's login page, so a visitor without a Facebook login cannot ask anything there.
findings.playbook_ref: §4 (no chat widgets; nothing covers the content or the booking action); §5
findings.fix_in_new_site: no widget; the question channel is a real wa.me link (bookingLinks[] or contact.whatsapp, see F8 notes) and contact.phone as tel:, both in the contact block repeated in the footer (playbook §3 item 9)
findings.notes: The 'Typically replies within a day' line is the Messenger widget's configured caption (Elfsight Facebook chat, button 'Start Chat'), not a WhatsApp reply time.

findings.title: WhatsApp is a 22-px footer link about nine screens down the lodge page, and every number is Israeli
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: On the lodge page the only WhatsApp link ('What’sup', 22 px high) is in the footer at about y 7,330 of the page; 'Call now' sits inside the closed menu and dials +972 9 973 3943; the lodge's own Sri Lankan number from its Google listing is nowhere on the site.
findings.playbook_ref: §5 (WhatsApp with a prefilled message, tel: beside it); §3 item 9
findings.fix_in_new_site: WhatsApp +972523593240 as a wa.me link with a prefilled message naming the lodge and the chosen level, and contact.phone as a tel: link, in the contact block and the footer (playbook §3 item 9); which phone (HQ +97299733943 or lodge +94770776747) is the owner's call
findings.notes: Schema interaction for the designer/deployer: site-content v0.7 makes a set contact.whatsapp the template's primary booking CTA. This audit's primary is the engine (dossier.booking.path). Keeping the engine primary means WhatsApp goes in as a bookingLinks[] row (https://wa.me/972523593240 is a valid https URL) with contact.whatsapp left empty — or Shahar decides WhatsApp is primary, which would change dossier.booking.path first. Positions from funnel.json (lodge page WhatsApp top 7332/7345, height 24/22).

findings.title: The site never says where the lodge is or when you can check in
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The lodge, level and contact pages give no address, no map link and no check-in or check-out time; the only map is an embedded Google Map on the unlinked packages page (F3).
findings.playbook_ref: §6 ('a site that hides where it is reads as a scam'; the Google listing address)
findings.fix_in_new_site: contact.address = the Google listing address (Henewatta Addara Gederawata, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka), contact.mapUrl = the Google listing, stayInfo.checkInFrom/checkInTo/checkOutTo from the dossier
findings.notes: HTML of the lodge, packages, level one, contact and home pages searched for Ahangama, Henewat…, Kathaluwa, check-in, +94 and map links: only the packages page's maps.google.com embed matched.

findings.title: The home page never says Sri Lanka, and its first button opens an empty engine
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The first screen reads 'Tailor-Made Surf Trips Like Never Before' over a video, then a destinations carousel that opens on the Maldives; the only button, 'READY TO CATCH MY FIRST WAVE', opens the engine's front page with a single 'Sri Lanka' tile.

value: READY TO CATCH MY FIRST WAVE

findings.fix_in_new_site: above the fold: businessName + tagline naming the lodge, Kabalana/Ahangama and 'surf camp' (what_where), then the level/price row and the engine action; the other four destinations get one copyBlocks[] row (slot 'info') lower on the page, never the first screen

findings.title: Dated pages still take bookings: a 2024 charter schedule, 2025 retreats, '© 2019'
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The Maldives Myna page shows 'Surf Charters Schedule - 2024' with every trip at 16 of 16 spots free and a BOOK NOW button; the retreats page lists '17-21 August 2025'; every footer says 'All rights reserved Global Surf Adventures 2019'.
findings.playbook_ref: §6 trust signals; §7 (prices carry their capture date)
findings.fix_in_new_site: no dated schedules or past retreats on the page; lessons[] prices show their capture date; the other destinations appear only as one undated copyBlocks[] row (slot 'info')

findings.title: Inside the engine it takes 8 more taps and one red error to reach the guest form
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: From a package page: Choose guests, +, Choose dates, a Saturday, Continue (which only scrolls to rooms and shows 'There is 1 guest left to assign.'), Select accommodation, Continue, Continue (an upgrades page of $0 items) before the guest form; the twin-room text says to 'mark the section box above' to reserve it privately.
findings.fix_in_new_site: bookingLinks[] rows open the product page directly, which removes the engine's front page and category taps (F1); the steps inside the engine are the engine's
findings.notes: In October 2026 only Saturday 3 and Saturday 24 were selectable check-ins for Level 1.

findings.title: Every action on the home page is under the 44-px tap size
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The hero button is 42 px high, CONTACT 34 px, the WhatsApp icon 22×24 px and the 'What’sup' link 22 px high.
findings.fix_in_new_site: template: every bookingLinks[] and contact action ≥ 44 px (playbook §4)

findings.title: Labels a visitor trips over
findings.what_a_visitor_meets: The lodge page shows the heading 'Choose your level' twice over paragraphs that are not about levels; the breadcrumb reads 'kabalan surf lodge'; the WhatsApp link says 'What’sup'; the engine calls Level 1 'Fomies' while the site says 'Foamie'.
findings.fix_in_new_site: lessons[].label and copyBlocks[].heading written by the copywriter; interface labels such as 'WhatsApp' are template strings

recommended.offer_framing: The site is the Kabalana lodge's (surf_camp), not the agency's. Three weekly packages as lessons[] rows (Level 1 first_time+beginner, Level 2 intermediate, Level 3 advanced; label with '7 nights'; includes only what site and engine agree on, else the engine's list; price USD per_person with capture date), each followed by its own bookingLinks[] row to its engine product page; rooms[] from the engine's room names with the supplement left to the engine; stayInfo check-in/out from the dossier and the Saturday start as stayInfo.note; amenities[] for pool, yoga, ice baths, co-working; Freestylers left out while it has no dates; a Booking.com bookingLinks[] row last, for room-only stays. The other four destinations (Maldives, Morocco, Angola, Mozambique) get one copyBlocks[] row, slot 'info', near the end: one short paragraph naming them from dossier.json#other_destinations[].text, no prices, no dates, no photos, no links of their own, pointing to the same WhatsApp and email.
recommended.closing_intent: send the reader to pick a level and see live dates in the engine, with WhatsApp named as the place to ask first

off_site.advice: open dates for the Freestylers package in Bookinglayer, or hide it until it has them
make each package's inclusion list in Bookinglayer match what the owner actually delivers
rewrite the twin-room note that points to a box the phone view does not show
if the Messenger chat stays anywhere, say that it needs a Facebook login and offer WhatsApp beside it
